lines.text: Your devices live in different worlds.
And sharing between them? It shouldn't be this hard.
Meet CrossDrop.
Share anything, with any device nearby.
One app, on every device. Mac, Android, iPhone, and Windows.
Open it, and nearby devices simply appear on your radar.
No pairing. No accounts. No cables.
Tap a device, pick your photos,
and they fly across at full Wi-Fi speed. Device to device, never through the cloud.
Done.
End-to-end encrypted. Nothing in between. Not even us.
Edited a huge video?
Only the changes travel.
Wi-Fi dropped?
It picks up right where it left off.
No app? No problem.
Anyone nearby can scan the code, and download right in their browser.
Turn your phone into a wireless drive.
Browse it from any Mac, PC, or browser,
and stream videos without copying a thing.
No cloud.
No accounts.
No ads.
No tracking.
Just drop it.
CrossDrop.
Available on Android, iOS, Mac, and Windows.
